title: admin.rs extract_query_param does not URL-decode percent-encoded values
description:
## What / Why
crates/transit/src/admin.rs extract_query_param() splits query strings on '&' and '=' to extract parameter values but does not percent-decode them. Query parameters from HTTP clients that encode values (e.g. a group name containing '+' or a CID with special characters) will be passed to downstream functions with the raw encoded form, causing lookup misses or unexpected behavior.

## Risk
An operator using the admin API with URL-encoded parameters (e.g. from curl's automatic encoding) will silently get wrong results with no error, making the API unreliable for automation.

## Fix
Apply percent-decoding (e.g. urlencoding::decode or percent_encoding::percent_decode_str) to extracted values before returning them. Already imported percent_encoding in crates/ctl/src/main.rs for this purpose.
